stem: Which statement describes an advantage of sexual reproduction when compared with asexual reproduction?

options.label: A
options.text: Sexual reproduction produces offspring that are almost always adapted to their environment.

options.label: B
options.text: Sexual reproduction produces genetically identical offspring, which are less likely to have genetic mutations.

options.label: C
options.text: Sexual reproduction requires less time and energy because a mate is not needed for reproduction.

options.label: D
options.text: Sexual reproduction introduces new gene combinations, which result in greater diversity within the population.
